violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was (0) parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Establishment not allowed to use dishwasher for sanitizing. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

Various food product was observed held at 48-55 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC voluntarily disposed product. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

Various food product was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

(Cheese ) packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

The door to the outside, located in the (back kitchen ), is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 07/21/2026

The 2 dr reach in and prep unit located in the kitchen and front counter area was not in good repair. Ambient temperatures observed at 45-49DF. Establishment not allowed to store any TCS products in unit until repaired and/or replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the (prep table shelves, knife holder, exterior can opener ) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

The condensate from the (2 dr reach in ) refrigeration unit is draining into a container. Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain into a drain. New Violation. Correct By: 07/21/2026

The floors throughout the kitchen have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (storage) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

Raw animal foods (such as raw meat) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as cheese) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. PIC moved the cheese. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 01/09/2025

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice machine taken out of service. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 01/09/2025

The presence of rodents is not controlled as evidenced by droppings in the walk-in cooler. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 01/09/2025
The non-food contact surfaces of the prep unit have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 01/09/2025

Handwashing aids (hand soap and hand washing sign) were observed at the 3-bay sink. Hand washing cannot take place at this 3-bay dish sink. Hand washing aids should be removed. New Violation. Correct By: 12/19/2024

Shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order and the date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. New Violation. Correct By: 12/19/2024

Raw animal foods (chicken) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (cooked produce and pasta) and a plate of cooked chicken was stored in a container with raw chicken in the two door refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw and cooked ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 12/19/2024

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener, salad spinner, and ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 12/19/2024

Meatballs and soup were observed held between 74-116 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC reheated during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 12/19/2024

Various items were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 12/19/2024

Chemical bottles were stored with food, equipment, utensils, or single service items. Chemicals must be stored to prevent the contamination of clean equipment, utensils linens, and/or single service by spacing or partitioning and locating them in an area that is not above food, equipment utensils, linens, and single service articles. New Violation. Correct By: 12/19/2024

Working containers of bread crumbs and flour were not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 12/19/2024

The presence of rodents is not controlled as evidenced by droppings in the kitchen, back kitchen storage area, and walk-in. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 12/19/2024

Bowls are being used as scoops in containers of dry ingredients. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. New Violation. Correct By: 12/19/2024
In use knives were observed stored between the prep table and prep unit. In use utensils must be stored on a clean service. New Violation. Correct By: 12/19/2024
Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils are not stored inverted. New Violation. Correct By: 12/19/2024

Utensils (plasticware) in the (front counter area) are displayed with the lip surface up. Utensils are to be stored so that only the handles are touched by employees and consumers if consumer self-service is provided. New Violation. Correct By: 12/19/2024
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the low temp dish washer. New Violation. Correct By: 12/19/2024
The non-food contact surfaces of the prep units have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 12/19/2024
